method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a declaration given by a claimant to Centrelink, a Secretary or the Repatriation Commission answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Income Tax Assessment Act 1936, the compilation registered as C2026C00333 (Federal Register of Legislation, retrieved 2026-09-22), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C1936A00027.txt; Part VA only (lines 11481-12100). No instrument brought in.

checks.command: l4 run itaa36-tfn.l4 ; l4 run itaa36-cases-tfn.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Part VA from the seat of the individual starting a job: s 202A (recipient, payer, tax file number, TFN declaration; 'child' defined but unused), s 202AA, s 202B, s 202BA(1)-(3), (5), (6), s 202BC, s 202BD(2), (6), s 202C, s 202CA(1)-(2) (a s 202CA(3) determination as an input), s 202CB(1)-(4), s 202CC, s 202CD(1)(b), s 202CE(1)-(3), (6), s 202CF(1), (1A), (3), s 202EA(2), s 202F(1). Out: Division 4 and ss 202EB-202EH (investments, entities, non-residents), Division 8, alienated personal services payments, s 202BA(4), ss 202BB, 202BE, 202BF (except as reviewable decisions), s 202CB(5), ss 202CB(6)-(8) and 202CE(7)-(9) (not covered), s 202CEA, s 202CF(2), s 202CG (except as s 202CF(1A)), s 202F(2)-(4), s 202FA. Read with taxation-administration-act-1953/encodings/baseline-2026-10 for s 8C(2), ss 8WA-8WB and Sch 1 s 12-35 withholding (not restated; cross-folder IMPORT is not possible).
seat: the individual starting a job (the applicant for a tax file number and the recipient of wages who may make a TFN declaration to the employer)
